remarks: Where comfort meets convenience. Welcome to 485 Summer Street a sundrenched corner 1 bedroom, 1 bath in the heart of downtown Stamford. Open Kitchen with granite countertops, SS appliances, tons of cabinets, and island seating for two opens right in to your living room. Living room drenched in natural light with wall of windows. Great sized bedroom with HUGE walk-in closet with ample space. Nicely updated bathroom with subway tile and granite counter top off this elevated space. Central air. Free Laundry in the hallway. 1 parking space in secure parking garage. Elevator building. Small Fitness Center on first floor. IMPORTANT: All applicants must have 3X income (min. 96k per year) and independently meet the property's published income, credit, and screening criteria. The property does not accept co-signers or guarantors. Pictures are from similar unit - not exact unit.
